email.subject: AI for Robertson, Anschutz, Schneid, Crane & Partners - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Ryan,

Your expansion to 18 locations across 18 states while managing creditors' rights and foreclosure matters at scale requires operational precision most legal tech doesn't address.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now expanding to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by Boca Raton to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw while maintaining your customizable workflows.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
